requirements.quote: Implementations need to maintain a buffer of CRYPTO data received out of order.
requirements.condition: When CRYPTO data is received out of order.
requirements.required_behavior: Maintain a buffer for the out-of-order CRYPTO data.
requirements.why_checkable: An implementation can be inspected or tested to determine whether out-of-order CRYPTO data is retained in a buffer for later processing.

requirements.quote: Implementations MUST support buffering at least 4096 bytes of data received in out-of-order CRYPTO frames.
requirements.condition: When data is received in out-of-order CRYPTO frames.
requirements.required_behavior: Support buffering at least 4096 bytes of that data.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not impose a supported out-of-order CRYPTO buffering capacity below 4096 bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can deliver up to 4096 bytes in out-of-order CRYPTO frames and verify that the implementation can buffer them.

requirements.quote: Endpoints MAY choose to allow more data to be buffered during the handshake.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint is permitted to buffer more than the mandatory minimum amount of out-of-order CRYPTO data.
requirements.why_checkable: The configured or observed handshake buffering limit can be checked to confirm that capacities above 4096 bytes are accepted as conforming behavior.

requirements.quote: An endpoint's buffer size does not need to remain constant during the life of the connection.
requirements.condition: During the life of a connection.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint is permitted to vary its CRYPTO buffer size over time.
requirements.why_checkable: Runtime observation or code inspection can determine whether the CRYPTO buffer limit is allowed to change across connection states.

requirements.quote: If an endpoint's buffer is exceeded during the handshake, it can expand its buffer temporarily to complete the handshake.
requirements.condition: The endpoint's CRYPTO buffer is exceeded during the handshake.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint is permitted to expand the buffer temporarily to complete the handshake.
requirements.why_checkable: A handshake test that exceeds the current buffer limit can verify whether temporary expansion is supported and confined to handshake completion.

requirements.quote: If an endpoint does not expand its buffer, it MUST close the connection with a CRYPTO_BUFFER_EXCEEDED error code.
requirements.condition: The endpoint's CRYPTO buffer is exceeded during the handshake and the endpoint does not expand it.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not keep the connection open after declining to expand the exceeded handshake CRYPTO buffer.
requirements.error_behavior: Use the CRYPTO_BUFFER_EXCEEDED error code when closing the connection.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can overflow the handshake CRYPTO buffer while preventing expansion and verify both connection closure and the emitted error code.

requirements.quote: Once the handshake completes, if an endpoint is unable to buffer all data in a CRYPTO frame, it MAY discard that CRYPTO frame and all CRYPTO frames received in the future, or it MAY close the connection with a CRYPTO_BUFFER_EXCEEDED error code.
requirements.condition: The handshake has completed and the endpoint cannot buffer all data in a CRYPTO frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Choose a permitted response: discard that CRYPTO frame and all CRYPTO frames received in the future, or close the connection.
requirements.error_behavior: If the endpoint chooses connection closure, use the CRYPTO_BUFFER_EXCEEDED error code.
requirements.why_checkable: A post-handshake buffer-exhaustion test can verify that the endpoint follows one of the two specified response branches and uses the required error code for the closure branch.

requirements.quote: Once the handshake completes, if an endpoint is unable to buffer all data in a CRYPTO frame, it MAY discard that CRYPTO frame and all CRYPTO frames received in the future
requirements.condition: After handshake completion, the endpoint cannot buffer all data in a CRYPTO frame and chooses the discard response.
requirements.required_behavior: Discard the unbufferable CRYPTO frame and every CRYPTO frame received afterward.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not resume accepting later CRYPTO frames after selecting the discard response.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can trigger the discard branch and then send later CRYPTO frames to verify that all such future frames are also discarded.

requirements.quote: Packets containing discarded CRYPTO frames MUST be acknowledged because the packet has been received and processed by the transport even though the CRYPTO frame was discarded.
requirements.condition: A received packet contains a CRYPTO frame that the endpoint discards.
requirements.required_behavior: Acknowledge the packet containing the discarded CRYPTO frame.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not withhold acknowledgment merely because the contained CRYPTO frame was discarded.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can send a packet whose CRYPTO frame is discarded and verify that the packet is nevertheless acknowledged.
